G4301.def:
προ-λαμβάνω
[in LXX: Wis.17:11 א2, Wis.17:17 א2B * ;]
__1. to take beforehand: with accusative, 1Co 11:21 (but see infr.).
__2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), Mc 14:8.
__3. to overtake, surprise: pass., Gl 6:1 (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).†
(AS)

G4302.def:
προ-λέγω
[in LXX: Is 41:26 (נָגַד hi.) * ;]
__1. to tell or say before­hand: 2Co 13:2, Gl 5:21, 1Ts 3:4 (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.).
__2. to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).†
(AS)

G4303.def:
προ-μαρτύρομαι
to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): 1Pe 1:11 (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).†
(AS)

G4306.def:
προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι,
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6:7, al. ;]
__1. to foresee.
__2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Rm 12:17 (-ούμενοι), 2Co 8:21 (-οῦμεν).
__3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1Tm 5:8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†
(AS)

G4307.def:
πρόνοια, -ας, ἡ
(πρόνοος, careful) [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) Wis.14:3 17:2, 4Mac.6:1-35 * ;]
foresight, forethought: At 24:3; π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: Rm 13:14.†
(AS)

G4308.def:
προ-οράω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sl 16:8) (שָׁוָה pi.), I Et 5:63 A * ;]
to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, At 21:29. Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, At 2:25 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4309.def:
προ-ορίζω
to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, Rm 8:30; id. and inf., At 4:28; id. before εἰς, 1Co 2:7, Ef 1:5; with dupl. accusative, Rm 8:26; pass., Ef 1:11.†
(AS)

G4310.def: to suffer first or beforehand , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: to be ill-treated before , ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4311.def:
προ-πέμπω
[in LXX: I Et 4:47, Jdth.10:15, Wis.19:2, 1Ma.12:4, 2Ma.6:23 * ;]
__1. to send before, send forth.
__2. to set forward on a journey, escort: with accusative of person(s), 1Co 16:11, Tt 3:13, 3Jn.6; before εἰς, At 20:38; οὗ, 1Co 16:6; ἕως, At 21:5; pass., At 15:3, Rm 15:24, 2Co 1:16.†
(AS)

G4312.def:
προπετής, -ές
(προπίπτω), [in LXX: Pv 10:14 (אֱוִיל) Pv 13:3 (פָּשַׂק) Sir.9:18 * ;]
falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, precipitate, rash, reck­less: of persons, 2Tm 3:4; of things, At 19:36.†
(AS)

G4313.def:
προ-πορεύω
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ, also for עָבַר, etc. ;]
to make to go before. Pass. and mid., to go before: Lc 1:76, At 7:40" (LXX) ,†
(AS)

G4314.def:
πρός,
prep. with genitive, dative, accusative
__I. I. C. genitive, of motion from a place, from the side of, hence metaphorically, in the interests of, At 27:34 (cf. Page, in l.).
__II. II. C. dative, of local proximity, hard by, near, at: Mc 5:11, Lc 19:37, Jo 18:16 20:11, 12 Ap 1:13.
__III. C. accusative, of motion or direction towards a place or object, to, towards.
__1. Of place,
__(a) after verbs of motion or of speaking and other words with the idea of direction: ἔρχομαι, ἀναβαίνω, πορεύομαι, λέγω, ἐπιστολή, etc., Mt 3:14, Mc 6:51, Lc 11:5, Jo 2:3, At 9:2, al. mult.; metaphorically, of mental direction, hostile or otherwise, Lc 23:12, Jo 6:52, 2Co 7:4, Ef 6:12, Cl 3:13, al.; of the issue or end, Lc 14:32, Jo 11:4, al.; of purpose, Mt 26:12, Rm 3:26, 1Co 6:5, al.; πρὸς τό, with inf., denoting purpose (cf. M, Pr., 218, 220; Lft., Notes, 131), Mt 5:28, Mc 13:22, Ef 6:11, 1Ts 2:9, al.;
__(b) of close proximity, at, by, with: Mt 3:10, Mc 11:4, Lc 4:11, At 3:2, al.; after εἶναι, Mt 13:56, Mc 6:3, Jo 1:1, al.
__2. 2. Of time,
__(a) towards (Plat., Xen., LXX: Gn 8:11, al.): Lc 24:29;
__(b) for: πρὸς καιρόν, Lc 8:13, 1Co 7:5; πρὸς ὥραν, Jo 5:35, al.; πρὸς ὀλίγον, Tg 4:14.
__3. Of relation
__(a) toward, with: Rm 5:1, 2Co 1:12, Cl 4:5, 1Ts 4:12, al.;
__(b) with regard to: Mt 19:8, Mc 12:12, Rm 8:31, al.;
__(with) pertaining to, to: Mt 27:4, Jo 21:22, Rm 15:17, Hb 2:17 5:1;
__(d) according to: Lc 12:47, 2Co 5:10, Gl 2:14, Ef 3:4 4:14;
__(e) in comparison with: Rm 8:18.
__IV. In composition: towards (προσέρχομαι), to (προσάγω), against (προσκόπτω), besides (προσδαπανάω) .
(AS)

G4316.def:
προσ-αγορεύω
[in LXX: Dt 23:6 (7) (דָּרַשׁ), ?Et 10:11 (יָדָה hith.), Wis.14:22, 1Ma.14:40, 2Ma.1:36 2Mac 4:7 2Mac 10:9 2Mac 14:37 * ;]
to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style: with dupl. accusative, pass., Hb 5:10.†
(AS)

G4317.def:
προσ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for = קָרַב hi., also for נָגַשׁ etc. ;]
__1. trans., to bring or lead: with accusative and dative, At 16:20; metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, 1Pe 3:18; before ὧδε, Lc 9:41; pass., with dative, Mt 18:24 (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, to summon: At 12:6 (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R).
__2. Intrans., to draw near, approach (Js 3:9, Jr 26:3 (Jr 46:3), al.): with dative, At 27:27 (WH, προσαχεῖν).†
(AS)

G4318.def:
προσ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσάγω),
__1. a bringing to.
__2. approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): Rm 5:2, Ef 2:18 3:12 (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).†
(AS)

G4319.def:
προσ-αιτέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jó 27:14 * ;]
__1. to ask besides.
__2. to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms: Jo 9:8.†
(AS)

G4320.def:
προσ-ανα-βαίνω
[in LXX: Êx 19:23, al. (עָלָה) ;]
__1. to go up besides.
__2. to go up higher: Lc 14:10.†
(AS)

G4321.def:
προσ-αναλίσκω
to spend besides: Lc 8:43 (WH, R, mg., om.).†
(AS)

G4322.def:
προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Wis.19:4 * ;]
to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: 2Co 9:12 11:9.†
(AS)

G4323.def:
προσ-ανα-τίθημι
to lay on or offer besides; mid.,
__(a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides;
__(b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: Gl 1:16 2:6 (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι)
(AS)

G4324.def:
προσ-απειλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir.13:3 א * ;]
to threaten further: At 4:21.†
(AS)

G4325.def:
προσδαπανάω, -ῶ
to spend besides: with accusative, Lc 10:35.†
SYN.: προσαναλίσκω (AS)

G4326.def:
προσ-δέομαι
[in LXX: Pv 12:9 חָסֵר חָסֵר Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
to want further, need in addition: At 17:25.†
(AS)

G4327.def:
προσ-δέχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for רָצָה ;]
__1. to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept: with accusative of person(s), Lc 15:2, Rm 16:2, Fp 2:29; with accusative of thing(s), At 24:15 (R, mg.), Hb 10:34 11:35.
__2. to expect, look for, wait for: with accusative of person(s), Lc 12:36; with accusative of thing(s), Mc 15:43, Lc 2:25, 38 23:51, At 23:21, Tt 2:13, Ju 21 (cf. δέχομαι).†
(AS)

G4328.def:
προσ-δοκάω, -ῶ
(the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω) [in LXX: Sl 104:27 (שָׂבַר pi.), etc. ;]
to await, expect: Mt 24:50, Lc 3:15 12:46, At 27:33 28:6; with accusative of person(s), Mt 11:3, Lc 1:21 7:19-20 8:40 At 10:24; with accusative of thing(s), 2Pe 3:12-14; with accusative and inf., At 28:6; with inf., At 3:5.†
(AS)

G4329.def:
προσδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(ιροσδοκάω), [in LXX: Gn 49:10 (יִקָּהָה), Sl 119:116 (שֵׂבֶר) Wis.17:13, Sir.40:2, al. ;]
expectation: with genitive obj., Lc 21:26; with genitive subjc., At 12:11.†
(AS)

G4330.def: to suffer to go further , τινά (New Testament) (ML)

G4332.def:
προσεδρεύω
(πρόσεδρος, sitting near), [in LXX: 1Ma.11:40 * ;]
__1. to sit near.
__2. to attend regularly: with dative, 1Co 9:13, Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).†
παρ-εδρεύω
[in LXX: Pv 1:21 8:3 * ;]
to sit constantly beside, attend constantly (cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, 1Co 9:13.†
(AS)

G4333.def:
προσ-εργάζομαι
__1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.).
__2. to gain besides, by working or trading: Lc 19:16 (Xen.).†
(AS)

G4334.def:
προσ-έρχομαι
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;]
to approach, draw near: absol., Mt 4:11, Lc 9:42, al.; with infin., Mt 24:1, al.; with dative loc., Hb 12:18, 22; dative of person(s), Mt 5:1, and freq., Jo 12:21, al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., Mt 8:2, and freq., Mc 1:31, Lc 7:14, al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., Mt 4:3, Mc 6:35,
Metaphorical,
__(a) of approaching God: absol. (Lv 21:17, Dt 21:5, al.), Hb 10:1, 22; τ. θεῷ, Hb 7:25 11:6; τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, Hb 4:16; πρὸς Χριστόν, 1Pe 2:4;
__(b) in sense not found elsewhere (Field, Notes, 211), to consent to: ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, 1Tm 6:3
(AS)

G4335.def:
προσ-ευχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσεύχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּפִלָּה ;]
__1. prayer to God: Mt 17:21 (WH, R, txt., om.) Mt 21:22, Mc 9:29, Lc 22:45, At 3:1 6:4 10:31, Rm 12:12, 1Co 7:5, Cl 4:2; pl., At 2:42 10:4, Rm 1:10, Ef 1:16 Cl 4:12, 1Ts 1:2, Phm 4 22, 1Pe 3:7 4:7, Ap 5:8 8:3-4; οἶκος προσευχῆς, Mt 21:13, Mc 11:17, Lc 19:46" (LXX) ; π. καὶ δέησις, Ef 6:18, Fp 4:6; pl., 1Tm 2:1 5:5; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. Wis.16:28), Lc 6:12; πρὸς τ. θεόν, before ὑπέρ, At 12:5; pl., Rm 15:30; Hebraistically (B1., § 38, 3), προσευχῇ προσεύχεσθαι, Tg 5:17 (EV, prayed fervently).
__2. a place of prayer: of a synagogue (3Ma.7:20, seel.; see Charles, APOT, i, 173; for other exx., see Kennedy, Sources, 114); of a place in the open (FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 23), At 16:13, 16.†
SYN.: see: δέησις (AS)

G4336.def:
προσ-εύχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for פָּלַל hith. ;]
to pray (always of prayer to God, or in cl., to gods): absol., Mt 6:5-7, 9 14:23 19:13 26:36, 39 26:41, 44, Mc 1:35 6:46 11:24-25 13:33 (WH, E, txt., om.) Mc 14:32, 38-39 Lc 1:10 3:21 5:16 6:12 9:18, 28-29 11:1-2 18:1, 10 22:44 (WH, E, mg., om.), At 1:24 6:6 9:11 10:9, 30 11:5 12:12 13:3 14:23 16:25 20:36 21:5 22:17 28:8, 1Co 11:4-5 14:14, 1Ts 5:17, 1Tm 2:8, Tg 5:13, 18; before λέγων, Mt 26:39, 42, Lc 22:41; with dative instr., 1Co 11:5 14:14-15; μακρά, Mt 23:14 (WH, R, txt., om.), Mc 12:40, Lc 20:47; ἐν πνεύματι (ἁγίῳ), Ef 6:18, Ju 20; προσευχῇ π. (a Hebraism, see: προσευχή), Tg 5:17; with accusative of thing(s), Lc 18:11, Rm 8:26; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Tg 5:14; with dative of person(s), Mt 6:6, 1Co 11:13; before περί, with genitive, At 8:15, Cl 1:3 4:3, 1Ts 5:25, 2Ts 1:11 3:1, Hb 13:18; ὑπέρ, Mt 5:44 Lc 6:28, Cl 1:9, Tg 5:16; before ἵνα, Mt 24:20, Mc 13:18 14:35, Lc 22:46, 1Co 14:13; τοῦτο ἵνα, Fp 1:9; with inf., Lc 22:46; before τοῦ, with inf. (Bl., § 71, 3), Tg 5:17.†
(AS)

G4337.def:
προσ-έχω
[in LXX for קָשַׁב hi., שָׁמַר ni., etc. ;]
__1. to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.).
__2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): At 8:6 16:14, Hb 2:1, 2Pe 1:19; in sense of caring or providing for, At 20:28; π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, Pr., 157; cf. Gn 24:6, Êx 10:28, al.): Lc 17:3 21:34, At 5:35; id. before ἀπό (M, Pr., 102; B1., § 34, 11; 40, 3; see: βλέπω), Lc 12:1; (without dative) Mt 7:15 10:17 16:6, 11-12, Lc 20:46 (cf. Sir.6:13, al.); before μή, with inf. (M, Pr., 193; Bl., § 69, 4), Mt 6:1.
__3. to attach or devote oneself to: with dative of person(s), At 8:10-11, 1Tm 4:1; with dative of thing(s), 1Tm 1:4 3:8 4:13 6:3 T (-ερχ-, WH, R), Tt 1:14, Hb 7:13.†
(AS)

G4338.def:
προσ-ηλόω -ῶ
[in LXX: 3Ma.4:9 * ;]
to nail to: with accusative and dative, figuratively, Cl 2:14.†
(AS)

G4339.def:
προσήλυτος, -ον
(προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר ;]
__1. one who has arrived, a stranger.
__2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): Mt 23:15, At 2:10 6:5 13:43.†
(AS)

G4340.def:
πρόσ-καιρος, -ον
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:2 4Mac 15:8 4Mac 15:23 * ;]
__1. in season.
__2. for a season, temporary, transient: 2Co 4:18, Hb 11:25; of plants, short-lived: Mt 13:21, Mc 4:17.†
(AS)

G4341.def:
προσ-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), Mt 10:1, Mc 3:13 6:7, Lc 7:19, At 5:40, Tg 5:14, al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: At 2:39; with inf., At 16:10 (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, At 13:2.†
(AS)

G4342.def:
προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ
(καρτερός, strong, stedfast) [in LXX: Nm 13:21 (חָזַק hith.), Tob.5:8 א, Da Th Su 1:6* ;]
to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), Mc 3:9, At 8:13 10:7; with dative of thing(s), At 1:14 2:42 6:4, Rm 12:12, Cl 4:2; before ἐν, At 2:46; εἰς, Rm 13:6.†
(AS)

G4344.def:
προσ-κεφάλαιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Eze.13:18, 20 (כֶּסֶת), I Et 3:8 * ;]
a pillow, cushion: Mc 4:38.†
(AS)

G4345.def:
προσ-κληρόω, -ῶ
to allot to, assign to by lot; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): At 17:4 (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).†
(AS)

G4347.def:
προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;]
to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, Js 23:8, Sir.6:34 al.), before πρός, Mc 10:7 (R, txt.), Ef 5:31 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4348.def:
πρόσ-κομμα, -τος, τό
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Êx 23:33 34:12 (מוֹקֵשׁ), Is 8:14 (נֶגֶף), Jdth.8:22, Sir.17:25, al. ;]
__(a) a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, Rm 9:32-33, 1Pe 2:8" (LXX) ;
__(b) = προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, Rm 14:13, 20, 1Co 8:9 (Plut.).†
SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)

G4349.def:
προσκοπή, -ῆς, ή
(προσκόπτω), [in Gr. Ven.: Pv 16:18 (כִּשָּׁלוֹן) * ;]
an occasion of stumbling, offence: 2Co 6:3.†
(AS)

G4350.def:
προσ-κόπτω
[in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc. ;]
__1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, Mt 4:6, Lc 4:11, (LXX)
__2. Intrans., to stumble: absol. (Tob.11:9, Pv 3:23), Jo 11:9-10; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, Mt 7:27. Metaphorical, in late writers,
__(a) to offend (Polyb.);
__(b) to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, Rm 14:21; with dative, τ. λόγῳ, 1Pe 2:8; τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, Rm 9:32.†
(AS)

G4351.def:
προσ-κυλίω
to roll up, roll to: with accusative and dative, Mt 27:60; accusative before ἐπί, Mc 15:46.†
(AS)

G4352.def:
προσ-κυνέω, -ῶ
(κυνέω, to kiss), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחָה hith. ;]
to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship;
__(a) prop. (as in cl., of the gods: Hdt., Æsch., Plat., al.), of God, Christ and supra-mundane beings: absol., Jo 4:20 12:20, At 8:27 24:11, Hb 11:21 (Westc., in l), Ap 11:1; πίπτειν καὶ π., Ap 5:14; with dative (of the significance of this constr. as com­pared with the usual cl., with accusative, see Abbott, JG, 78 f.; JV, 133 ff.), Jo 4:21, 23, At 7:43, 1Co 14:25, Hb 1:6, Ap 4:10 7:11 11:16 13:4, 15 14:7 16:2 19:4, 10 19:20 22:8-9; with accusative (see supr.), Mt 4:10, Lc 4:8 24:52 (WH, R, mg., om.), Jo 4:22, 24, Ap 9:20 13:4, 8 13:12 14:9, 11 20:4; Seq. ἐπώπιον, Lc 4:7, Ap 15:4;
__(b) as in cl., of homage to human superiors (cf. MM, xxi): absol., Mt 20:20, At 10:25; with dative (see supr.), Mt 2:2, 8 8:2 9:18 14:33 15:25 18:26 28:9, Mc 15:19, Jo 9:38; πεσὼν., Mt 2:11 4:9; ἐνώπιον τ. ποδῶν, Ap 3:9; with accusative, Mc 5:6 (dative T).†
(AS)

G4354.def:
προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Êx 4:16 AB2 (דָבַר pi.), Wis.13:17 * ;]
to speak to: At 28:20; with dative of person(s), At 13:43.†
(AS)

G4355.def:
προσ-λαμβάνω
[in LXX: Sl 18:16 (מָשָׁה hi.), Sl 73:24 (לָקַח), etc. ;]
__1. to take in addition.
__2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι;
__(a) of things: of food, with accusative, At 27:33; with genitive part., At 27:36;
__(b) of persons: with accusative, Mt 16:22, Mc 8:32 (see Swete, in l), At 17:5 18:26 28:2, Rm 14:1, 3 15:7, Phm 17.†
(AS)

G4356.def:
πρόσ-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις, as in Att..), -εως, ἡ
(προσλαμβάνω),
__1. an assumption (Plat.).
__2. a receiving (cf. προσλαμβάνω): Rm 11:15,†
(AS)

G4357.def:
προσ-μένω
[in LXX: Jz 3:25 A (חוּל hi.), Tob.2:2 א, Wis.3:9, 3Ma.7:17 * ;]
__1. to wait longer, continue, remain still: At 18:18; before ἐν, 1Tm 1:3.
__2. C. dative, to remain with: Mt 15:32, Mc 8:32. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, At 11:23 (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, At 13:43; τ. δεήσεσιν, 1Tm 5:5.†
(AS)

G4358.def:
προσ-ορμίζω
(ὅρμος, an anchorage),
to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): Mc 6:53.†
(AS)

G4359.def: to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4360.def:
προσ-οχθίζω
[in LXX: Lv 26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lv 18:25, al. (קוֹא), Sl 95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;]
to be angry with: with dative, Hb 3:10 (LXX), Hb 3:17.†
(AS)

G4362.def:
προσ-πήγνυμι
to fasten to: absol., to crucify, At 2:23.†
(AS)

G4363.def:
προσ-πίπτω
[in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;]
__1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Mt 7:25.
__2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Mc 7:25; with dative of person(s), Mc 3:11 5:33, Lc 8:28, At 16:29; τ. γόνασιν, Lc 5:8.†
(AS)

G4364.def:
προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Rs 21:13 (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), Jó 19:14, (Sir 34:30 (Sir.31:30)), Dan LXX Su 1:11 * ;]
to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: Lc 24:28.†
(AS)

G4365.def:
προσ-πορεύομαι
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;]
to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), Mc 10:35.†
(AS)

G4366.def:
προσ-ρήγνυμι
[in Aq.: Sl 2:9 * ;]
to break against, dash against;
__(a) trans. (παιδία πέτραις, FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 6);
__(b) intrans., with dative: Lc 6:48-49 (cf. προσπίπτω).†
(AS)

G4367.def:
προσ-τάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;]
__1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to.
__2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Lc 5:14; with dative of person(s), Mt 1:24; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 8:4, Mc 1:44; with accusative and inf., At 10:48; pass., At 10:33 17:26.†
(AS)

G4368.def:
προστάτις, -ιδος, ἡ
(fem, of προοτάτης),
a patroness, protectress: Rm 16:2.†
(AS)

G4369.def:
προσ-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;]
__1. to put to.
__2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, Mt 6:27, Lc 3:20 12:25; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, At 2:47; with accusative and dative, Lc 17:5, Hb 12:19 (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., At 2:41, Gl 3:19; with dative, Mt 6:33, Mc 4:24, Lc 12:31, At 5:14 11:24; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. Gn 26:8, Jz 2:10, al.), At 13:36; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in Heb. idiom (Gn 4:2 8:12, al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, Pr., 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi), Lc 20:11, At 12:3; similarly ptcp., προσ-θείς, with indic. (Gn 38:5, al.), Lc 19:11.†
(AS)

G4370.def:
προσ-τρέχω
[in LXX for רוּץ ;]
to run to: Mc 9:15 10:17, At 8:30.†
(AS)

G4371.def:
προσφάγιον, -ου, τό
(φαγεῖν),
Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον)
a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), to be eaten with bread: Jo 21:5 (have ye taken any fish, Field, Notes, 109; Abbott, Essays, 105; cf. M, Pr., 170n; MM, Exp., xxi).†
(AS)

G4372.def:
πρόσφατος, -ον
(on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως), [in LXX: Nm 6:3 (לַח), Dt 32:17, Ec 1:9 (חָדָשׁ), Sl 81:9 (זוּר), Sir.9:10 * ;]
__1. originally, freshly slain.
__2. Generally (from Æsch. on), new, fresh, recent: ὁδός, Hb 10:20 (see MM, Exp., xxi; Rutherford, NPhr., 471 f.).†
(AS)

G4373.def:
προσφάτως
adv. (see: πρόσφατος), [in LXX: Dt 24:5 (חָדָשׁ), Jdth.4:3, 5, Eze.11:3, 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 14:16 ;]
recently: At 18:2 (see MM, Exp., xxi).†
(AS)

G4374.def:
προσ-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi. ;]
__1. to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), Mt 4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16, Mc 2:4 (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) Mc 10:13, Lc 18:15 23:14; pass., Mt 12:22 (act., WH, txt.) Mt 18:24 (προσήχθη, WH) Mt 19:13; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 25:20; id. with dative of person(s), Mt 22:19, Lc 23:36; τ. στόματι, Jo 19:29; metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, Hb 12:7 (cl.).
__2. to offer: Mt 2:11, At 8:18; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, Ant., iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, gifts and prayers to God: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), Mc 1:44, Lc 5:14, Hb 5:1, 3 9:7 10:12; pass., At 21:26; with accusative of thing(s) (δῶρον, θυσίαν, λυτρείαν, προσφοράν), Mt 5:23-24 (aoristic pres.; M, Pr., 247) Mt 8:4, Jo 16:2, At 7:42 21:26, Hb 5:1 8:3-4 9:7, 9 10:1-2, 8 10:11-12; δεήσεις τε κ. ἱκετηρίας, Hb 5:7; with accusative of person(s), Hb 11:17 (conative impf.; M, Pr., 129); of Christ, Hb 7:27 (ἀνενέγκας, WH, txt.) Hb 9:14, 25 9:28.†
(AS)

G4375.def:
προσφιλής, -ές
(φιλέω), [in LXX: Et 5:1, Sir.4:7 20:13 * ;]
__(a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with);
__(b) of things, pleas­ing, agreeable (EV, lovely): Fp 4:8.†
(AS)

G4376.def:
προσ-φορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(προσφέρω), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:48 (פָּנִים) Sl 40:6 (מִנְחָה), I Et 5:52, Sir.14:11, al. ;]
__1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.).
__2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: At 21:26 24:17, Ef 5:2, Hb 10:5, 8 10:14; περί ἀμαρτίας, Hb 10:18; with genitive obj., Rm 15:16, Hb 10:10.†
(AS)

G4377.def:
προσ-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Es.2:21 Et 6:6 Et 6:22, 2Ma.15:15 * ;]
__1. to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): At 21:40 In late writers, with dative of person(s): Mt 11:16, Lc 7:32 13:12 23:20, At 22:2.
__2. to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), Lc 6:13.†
(AS)

G4378.def:
πρόσ-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
a pouring or sprinkling upon: Hb 11:28.†
(AS)

G4379.def:
προσ-ψαύω
in poët. and late writers,
to touch: with dative, Lc 11:46.†
(AS)

G4380.def:
προσωπολημπτέω (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ
(-λήμπτης, which see),
to have respect of persons: Tg 2:9.†
(AS)

G4381.def:
προσωπο-λήμπτης (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ
(πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον),
a respecter of persons: At 10:34 (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 44).†
(AS)

G4382.def:
προσωπολημψία (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ
(προσωπολήμπτης)
respect of persons: Rm 2:11, Ef 6:9, Cl 3:25, Tg 2:1 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G4383.def:
πρόσωπον, -ου, τό
(πρός, ὤψ), [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים ;]
__1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.);
__(a) the face, countenance: Mt 6:16-17, Mc 14:65, Lc 9:29, 2Co 3:7, Ap 4:7, al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), Tg 1:23; πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., Mt 17:6, Lc 5:12, Ap 7:11, al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., Gl 1:22; π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, 1Ts 2:17; κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, At 25:16, 2Co 10:1 10:7, Gl 2:11; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, Pr., 99 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.), Lc 2:31, At 3:13; similarly ἀπὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים מִלִּפְּנֵי); see Dalman, Words, 29), from the presence of, At 3:19 5:41 7:45, 2Ts 1:9, Ap 12:14 20:11; πρὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים לִפְנֵי), before, Mt 11:10, Mc 1:2, Lc 7:27" (LXX), al.; in other phrases resembling Heb. idiom (Thackeray, Gr., 42), βλέπειν (ὁρᾶν, θεωρεῖν, ἰδεῖν) τὸ π., to see one's face, i.e. see him in person, Mt 18:10, At 20:25, 38, 1Ts 3:10, Ap 22:4; ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Hb 9:24; ἐν π. Χριστοῦ, 2Co 2:10 4:6; μετὰ τοῦ π. σου with thy presence, At 2:28 (LXX); εἰς π. τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν, 2Co 8:24; στηρίζειν τὸ π. (Heb. פָּנִים שׂוּם: Jr 21:10, al.; see Dalman, Words, 30), with inf., to set one's face towards, Lc 9:51; similarly, τὸ π. αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον (op. cit., 31), Lc 9:53; τὸ π. τοῦ κυρίου ἐπί, 1Pe 3:12 (LXX)
__(b) form, person: καυχᾶσθαι. ἐν π. καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ, 2Co 5:12 (cf. 1Rs 16:7); metaphorically, as in Heb. idiom, of judgment according to appearance, external condition or circumstances (פָּנִים H5387; see Dalman, Words, 30; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.): λαμβάνειν π., Lc 20:21, Gl 2:6; βλέπειν εἰς π., Mt 22:16, Mc 12:14; θαυμάζειν πρόσωπα, Ju 16.
__2. Of things (cf. Dalman, l.with)
__(a) face, appearance (Sl 104:30): Mt 16:3 (WH, R, mg., om.), Lc 12:56, Tg 1:11
__(b) surface (Gn 2:6): Lc 21:35, At 17:26
(AS)

G4385.def:
προ-τείνω, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;]
to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), At 22:25.†
(AS)

G4386.def:
before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time
former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, formerly, Jn. 6:62

G4387.def:
A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;]
before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: Ef 4:22. Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: Jo 7:50, 2Co 1:15, Hb 4:6; opposite to ἔπειτα, Hb 7:27; τὸ π., Jo 6:62 9:8, Gl 4:13, 1Tm 1:13; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, Hb 10:32; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe 1:14.†
(AS)

G4388.def:
προ-τίθημι
[in LXX: Êx 40:4, 23, Lv 24:8 (עָרַךְ) Sl 54:3 (שׂוּם), etc. ;]
__1. to set before, set forth publicly; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), Rm 3:25 (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii).
__2. Mid., to set before oneself, propose, purpose: with inf., Rm 1:13; with accusative of thing(s), Ef 1:9.†
(AS)

G4389.def:
προ-τρέπω
[in LXX: Wis.14:18, 2Ma.11:7, 4Ma.12:7 4Mac 15:12 4Mac 16:13 * ;]
to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): At 18:27.†
(AS)

G4390.def:
προ-τρέχω
[in LXX: 1Rs 8:11 (פָּנִים רוּץ), Jó 41:13 (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;]
__1. to run forward.
__2. to run on, run in advance: Jo 20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Lc 19:4.†
(AS)

G4391.def:
προ-ϋπ-άρχω
[in LXX: Job 42:18* ;]
__1. to be beforehand in.
__2. to be before or previously: with ptcp., Lc 23:12, At 8:9.†
(AS)

G4392.def:
πρό-φασις, -εως, ἡ
(φήμι), [in LXX: Sl 141:4 (עֲלִילָה), ??עֲלִילָה), ??Dn 6:4-5(5-6) (עִלָּה) Pv 18:1, Os 10:4 * ;]
a pretence, pretext: Mt 23:1 (WM, R, txt., om.), Mc 12:40, Lc 20:47 Jo 15:22, At 27:30, Fp 1:18, 1Ts 2:5.†
(AS)

G4393.def:
προφέρω
[in LXX: Pv 10:13 (מָצָא ni.), Tob.9:5, al. ;]
to bring forth: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, Lc 6:45.†
(AS)

G4394.def:
προφητεία, -ας, ἡ
(προψητεύω) [in LXX for נְבוּאָה, חָזוֹן ;]
the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, prophecy, prophesying: of OT prophecy, Mt 13:14, 2Pe 1:20-21; of NT prophecy, Rm 12:6, 1Co 12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22, 1Tm 4:14, Ap 11:6 22:19; pl., 1Co 13:8, 1Ts 5:20, 1Tm 1:18; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., Ap 1:3 22:7, 10 22:18; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., Ap 19:10 (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4395.def:
προφητεύω
(προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;]
to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, Mt 7:22 26:68, Mc 14:65, Lc 1:67 22:64, At 19:6, 1Co 11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39, Hb 11:3; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), Mt 11:13, At 2:17-18" (LXX) At 21:9; before περί, Mt 15:7, Mc 7:6, 1Pe 1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Ap 10:11; λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, Jo 11:51.†
SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)

G4396.def:
προφήτης, -ου, ὁ [πρόφημι, to speak forth),
[in LXX chiefly for נָבִיא ;]
one who acts as an interpreter or forth-teller of the Divine will (see Lft., Notes, 83f.; Tr., Syn., §vi), a prophet;
__1. in cl. (Æsch., Hdt., Plat., al.), of the interpreters of oracles.
__2. In NT,
__(a) of the OT prophets: Mt 5:12, Mc 6:15, Lc 4:27, Jo 8:52, Rm 11:3, al.;
__(b) of prophets in general: Mt 10:41 13:57 21:46, Mc 6:4, Lc 13:33, al.;
__(with) of John the Baptist: Mt 21:26, Mc 6:15, Lc 1:76;
__(d) of Christ: Mt 21:11, Jo 6:14, At 3:22, 23 7:37" (LXX) ;
__(e) of Christian prophets in the apostolic age: At 15:32, 1Co 12:28, Ef 2:20, al.;
__(f) by meton., of the writings of prophets: Lc 24:27, At 8:28, al.;
__(g) of a poet: Tt 1:12 (on the use of the term in π. and Inscr., see Deiss., BS, 235f.; MM, xxii).
(AS)

G4398.def:
προφῆτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of προφήτης,
[in LXX: Êx 15:20, Jz 4:4, 4Ki.22:14, 2Cr 34:22, Is 8:3 (נְבִיאָה) * ;]
a prophetess: Lc 2:36, Ap 2:20.†
(AS)

G4399.def:
προ-φθάνω
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַם pi. ;]
with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see),
to anticipate: Mt 17:25.†
(AS)
